topography.project_purpose: Yield Aggregator. Structurally: 65 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 8 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 19 common project-authored base contract(s) (reentrancyguardtransient, tokenbalancehelper, constants). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
